# Florian Molea

> Florian Molea is a Romanian category B driving instructor and educational content creator based in Bucharest, focused on driving education, exam routes and road safety. This site helps visitors book lessons through WhatsApp, discover long-form YouTube exam-route videos, and find Florian's official social media channels.

## Main pages (general visitors)

- [Homepage](https://florianmolea.ro/): driving lessons overview, YouTube spotlight, social hub and FAQ.
- [Privacy Policy](https://florianmolea.ro/privacy-policy.html)
- [Cookie Policy](https://florianmolea.ro/cookies-policy.html)
- [Terms and Conditions](https://florianmolea.ro/terms-and-conditions.html)

## Pages for brands and partners

- [Parteneriate / Live Media Kit](https://florianmolea.ro/parteneriate.html): audience data, platform statistics, top videos, collaboration formats and prior partnerships for brands interested in working with Florian Molea.
